verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including opting out of usage tracking or data use, is a fair question for a cloud speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. HIPAA-compliant processing and on-prem deployment are related privacy features but a different capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
